title: If This Be My Destiny...!
description: Spider-Man battles the Master Planner (Doctor Octopus in disguise) while Aunt May's life hangs in the balance. Culminates in the legendary ASM #33.

title: The Goblin's Identity Revealed
description: The Green Goblin discovers Spider-Man's secret identity and Peter learns who the Goblin truly is.

title: Goblin Reborn
description: Stan Lee tackled drug addiction without Comics Code Authority approval. Harry Osborn overdoses on pills.

title: The Six-Armed Saga
description: Spider-Man takes a serum to remove his powers but grows four extra arms. Leads to the introduction of Morbius.

title: The Kingpin Tablet Saga
description: The Kingpin steals a mysterious ancient tablet and Spider-Man must retrieve it across multiple battles.

title: The Nullifier Saga
description: Doctor Octopus steals the Nullifier device and uses it to cause Spider-Man to lose his memory.

title: The Night Gwen Stacy Died
description: One of the most pivotal moments in Spider-Man history. The Green Goblin kills Gwen Stacy. Norman Osborn then dies.

title: Harry Osborn as the Green Goblin
description: Harry Osborn discovers Peter is Spider-Man and becomes the second Green Goblin.

title: The Original Clone Saga
description: The Jackal clones Spider-Man and both the clone and the original must face off. Leads to the first appearance of the Spider-Clone (Ben Reilly) and return of Gwen Stacy ?!?.

title: Spider-Man No More
description: The Kingpin's debut and rise to power as New York's greatest crime lord beginning with Spider-Man No More.

title: The Death of Captain Stacy
description: The tragic death of Captain Stacy and its impact on the Spider-Man universe.

title: The Ghost of Hammerhead
description: Doctor Octopus is haunted by the apparent ghost of Hammerhead while Spider-Man is caught in the middle.

title: The Third Green Goblin
description: Bart Hamilton, Harry Osborn's psychiatrist, becomes the third Green Goblin and faces Spider-Man across a multi-issue arc.

title: The Black Cat Strikes
description: First appearances of the Black Cat, Felicia Hardy, who becomes one of Spider-Man's most complex love interests.

title: Death of the Burglar
description: Spider-Man finally confronts the burglar responsible for Uncle Ben's death in the landmark 200th issue.

title: Nothing Can Stop the Juggernaut!
description: One of the greatest Spider-Man stories ever told. Spider-Man must stop the unstoppable Juggernaut alone to save Madame Web.

title: The Hobgoblin Lives!
description: The debut of the Hobgoblin, one of Spider-Man's greatest mysteries. Who is behind the mask?

title: The Hobgoblin Returns
description: The Hobgoblin returns and fakes his death, deepening the mystery of his true identity.

title: The Black Costume Saga
description: Spider-Man returns from Secret Wars with an alien symbiote costume that begins to take control of him. Leads directly to the creation of Venom.

title: Gang War
description: New York's criminal underworld erupts in all-out war following the Kingpin's fall from power. Spider-Man is caught in the middle.

title: The Hobgoblin Revealed
description: The mystery of the Hobgoblin's identity is finally solved — or is it? Ned Leeds is revealed as the Hobgoblin.

title: Kraven's Last Hunt
description: The greatest Spider-Man story ever told. Kraven the Hunter buries Spider-Man alive and takes his place. Dark, literary, and unforgettable.

title: Peter Parker Proposes
description: Peter Parker finally proposes to Mary Jane Watson and she says yes.

title: The Birth of Venom
description: Eddie Brock bonds with the alien symbiote to become Venom, culminating in the landmark ASM #300.

title: The Return of Venom
description: Venom returns to terrorize Spider-Man and Mary Jane in a brutal three-part story.

title: Return of the Sinister Six
description: Doctor Octopus reassembles the Sinister Six for a devastating assault on Spider-Man.

title: Venom Lives!
description: Venom escapes from prison and leaves part of the symbiote behind with Cletus Kasady, setting up the birth of Carnage.

title: Carnage
description: The first full appearance of Carnage. Cletus Kasady bonds with the Venom symbiote offspring to become one of Spider-Man's most dangerous foes.

title: Maximum Carnage
description: Carnage leads a gang of villains on a murderous rampage through New York. Spider-Man and Venom must reluctantly team up.

title: Web of Death
description: Doctor Octopus discovers Spider-Man's secret identity and infects him with a fatal virus. Mary Jane is pregnant.

title: The Clone Saga
description: The return of the Spider-Clone sets off the Clone Saga. Ben Reilly and Peter Parker must determine who is the real Spider-Man.

title: The Death of Aunt May
description: In the landmark 400th issue, Aunt May tells Peter she knows he is Spider-Man before passing away peacefully.

title: Vol. 2 Relaunch
description: Spider-Man relaunches with a fresh status quo after the Clone Saga, returning Peter Parker to his classic roots.

title: Coming Home
description: JMS's debut arc introduces Ezekiel and the totem mythology, reframing Spider-Man's origin. Morlun makes his first devastating appearance.

title: The Conversation
description: Peter finally tells Aunt May he is Spider-Man in a quiet, devastating one-issue story decades in the making.

title: Happy Birthday
description: A time-travel story celebrating legacy issue #500. Peter visits past and future versions of himself in an emotionally resonant milestone.

title: The Book of Ezekiel
description: Morlun returns and Ezekiel's totem arc reaches its conclusion. The payoff of everything JMS seeded in Coming Home.

title: Sins Past
description: It is revealed that Gwen Stacy secretly had Norman Osborn's children. A divisive but permanently canonical story with lasting consequences.

title: The Other: Evolve or Die
description: Peter Parker dies and is reborn with new instinctual spider abilities, setting up his enhanced status heading into Civil War.

title: Civil War
description: Peter unmasks on live television in support of the Superhero Registration Act — one of the most consequential moments in Spider-Man history.

title: Back in Black
description: Aunt May is shot as a direct consequence of Peter's unmasking. He returns to the black suit and hunts the Kingpin in a brutal, unrelenting arc.

title: One More Day
description: Peter makes a deal with Mephisto to save Aunt May, erasing his marriage to MJ. Resets the entire status quo of the series.

title: Brand New Day
description: The post-OMD relaunch. New status quo, new supporting cast, and the introduction of Menace and Freak across a rotating team of writers.

title: Kraven's First Hunt
description: Ana Kravinoff buries Spider-Man alive as her initiation into the hunt, a critical setup for the Grim Hunt.

title: New Ways to Die
description: Anti-Venom debuts as Eddie Brock is reborn. Norman Osborn as H.A.M.M.E.R. director confronts Spider-Man directly.

title: The Gauntlet: Kaine Setup
description: Kaine and Ben Reilly's history is revisited, foreshadowing Kaine's sacrifice in the Grim Hunt.

title: The Gauntlet: Electro
description: Electro is reframed as a populist revolutionary channeled by the Kravinoffs, opening the Gauntlet and setting its tone.

title: The Gauntlet: Sandman
description: Keemia's Castle — one of the most emotionally complex Sandman stories ever told, as he believes a child is his daughter.

title: The Gauntlet: Rhino
description: A new, deadlier Rhino is sent to kill the original. Rage of the Rhino is a gut-wrenching single issue and one of the best in the Slott era.

title: The Gauntlet: Mysterio
description: Mysterio returns as a genuine threat after years of irrelevance, working with the Maggia and setting up his role in the Gauntlet.

title: The Gauntlet: Vulture
description: A new, savage Vulture is introduced as one of the Kravinoffs' assets, raising the stakes of the coming Grim Hunt.

title: Shed
description: The Lizard permanently devours Curt Connors' humanity — and kills his own son. One of the darkest transformations in Spider-Man history.

title: The Grim Hunt
description: Kraven's family hunts Peter and every spider-hero. Kaine dies sacrificing himself. The Kravenoffs are resurrected. The Gauntlet's devastating conclusion.

title: Big Time
description: Dan Slott's solo era begins. Peter lands his dream job at Horizon Labs, Phil Urich becomes the new Hobgoblin, and Flash Thompson becomes Agent Venom.

title: Spider-Island
description: Everyone in Manhattan develops spider powers via the Jackal and the Spider-Queen. MJ gains powers, and Kaine is cured to become the Scarlet Spider.

title: Ends of the Earth
description: A dying Doctor Octopus enacts a global master plan to be remembered as a hero. Silver Sable apparently dies stopping him.

title: Dying Wish
description: Doctor Octopus swaps minds with Peter Parker. Peter dies in Ock's failing body, spending his last moments proving what it means to be Spider-Man.

title: Superior Spider-Man: A Superior Beginning
description: Otto Octavius, now in Peter Parker's body, vows to be a better Spider-Man while Peter's ghost fights desperately to reclaim control.

title: Troubled Mind
description: Peter's consciousness resurfaces inside Ock's mind, forcing a confrontation. Ock ultimately destroys Peter's remaining memories to fully take control.

title: No Escape
description: Superior Spider-Man takes on the Vulture and the Massacre, revealing Ock's willingness to cross moral lines Peter never would.

title: Goblin Nation
description: The Goblin King's army overruns New York. Ock is forced to admit defeat and restore Peter Parker, sacrificing himself to save Anna Maria.

title: Peter Returns
description: Peter Parker reclaims his body and life after the Superior Spider-Man era, rebuilding what Ock destroyed while establishing Parker Industries.

title: Spider-Verse
description: The Inheritors hunt Spider-totems across the multiverse. Peter leads a Spider-Army spanning every alternate reality to stop the slaughter. Silk and Spider-Gwen debut.

title: The Graveyard Shift
description: Peter juggles Parker Industries and his identity as Silk's connection puts them both in danger, closing out Vol 3 before Secret Wars.

title: Worldwide
description: Peter Parker runs Parker Industries as a global tech company, operating as Spider-Man from a position of wealth and resources for the first time.

title: The Dark Kingdom
description: Spider-Man faces Mister Negative and the Inner Demons in a personal arc tied to Martin Li's connection to Aunt May and F.E.A.S.T.

title: Go Down Swinging
description: Norman Osborn bonds with the Carnage symbiote to become the Red Goblin, the most dangerous version of the Green Goblin ever. A career-defining confrontation.

title: Fall of Parker
description: Parker Industries collapses and Peter loses everything he built, forcing him back to his street-level roots heading into the Nick Spencer era.

title: Back to Basics
description: Nick Spencer's debut arc restores Peter Parker to his classic struggling status quo — broke, unlucky, and back in New York — while seeding the mystery of Kindred.

title: Heist
description: Black Cat assembles a crew to steal from Spider-Man, kicking off a long-running criminal subplot that redefines Felicia Hardy's role in the Spencer run.

title: Hunted
description: Kraven the Hunter traps Spider-Man and dozens of animal-themed villains in Central Park as prey, seeking a death worthy of his legacy.

title: Sins Rising
description: The resurrected Sin-Eater, empowered by Kindred, targets Spider-Man's rogues gallery. Norman Osborn is cleansed of the Green Goblin persona, setting up Last Remains.

title: Last Remains
description: Kindred is revealed as Harry Osborn's corrupted soul, the consequence of Peter's deal with Mephisto. The darkest arc of Spencer's run with a Spider-Family-wide confrontation.

title: The Chameleon Conspiracy
description: The Chameleon's true identity and agenda are exposed, with ties to Teresa Parker and a spy network threatening Peter's family history.

title: Sinister War
description: Multiple Sinister Six line-ups battle simultaneously over Spider-Man, with Kindred manipulating every faction toward a single devastating endgame.

title: Beyond
description: Ben Reilly returns as the official Spider-Man under the Beyond Corporation while a wounded Peter recovers, closing out the Spencer era.

title: Peter Parker: Spectacular Spider-Man Debuts
description: The launch of Spider-Man's second ongoing series, establishing Peter Parker's street-level New York world alongside the main ASM title.

title: The Death of Jean DeWolff
description: The Sin-Eater murders NYPD Captain Jean DeWolff, pushing Spider-Man and Daredevil to their moral limits in one of the greatest Spectacular stories ever told.

title: Harry Osborn: The Green Goblin Returns
description: Harry Osborn's tragic descent into becoming the Green Goblin again, culminating in his death saving Peter Parker in the landmark #200.

title: Torment
description: Todd McFarlane's debut arc on his own Spider-Man title. A dark, atmospheric five-parter pitting Spider-Man against a supernaturally powered Lizard.

title: Web of Spider-Man Debuts
description: The launch of Web of Spider-Man, Spider-Man's third ongoing series, expanding his world further into street-level New York.

title: Power and Responsibility
description: Bendis retells Spider-Man's origin for the Ultimate universe — Peter Parker bitten, Uncle Ben killed, the weight of responsibility beginning. A modern reinvention that made the character feel new.

title: Learning Curve
description: Peter confronts the Ultimate Kingpin for the first time, learning the brutal reality of New York's criminal underworld. Introduces Elektra and sets the tone for the entire run.

title: Doctor Octopus / Public Scrutiny
description: Ultimate Doc Ock debuts as a former OsCorp scientist with fused tentacles. Peter's double life begins fraying as the media turns on Spider-Man.

title: Legacy
description: Gwen Stacy enters Peter's life. Norman Osborn's Oz formula resurfaces and the Green Goblin threat begins building toward an inevitable confrontation.

title: Public Scrutiny
description: The Ultimate Venom origin — Eddie Brock and Peter discover the symbiote was a cancer cure invented by their fathers. One of the most personal Venom stories ever told.

title: Venom
description: Norman Osborn fully transforms into a Hulk-like Green Goblin and attacks Peter's school. One of the run's most explosive arcs, with massive consequences.

title: Cats and Kings
description: Black Cat enters Peter's life as a cat burglar with Hollywood connections, forcing Spider-Man into conflict with the Kingpin again.

title: Hollywood
description: A long-running arc involving Mysterio, Doc Ock, and the media's obsession with Spider-Man. Peter's life becomes increasingly complicated.

title: (Ultimate)Carnage
description: The Ultimate Carnage is revealed as a Clone of Gwen Stacy created from her DNA and the Venom symbiote. One of the most disturbing arcs in the run.

title: Hobgoblin
description: Harry Osborn is infected with a version of the Oz formula and becomes the Ultimate Hobgoblin, forcing Peter to face his best friend as a monster.

title: Warriors
description: Spider-Man gets caught between the Kingpin, the Hammerhead mob, and a gang war that threatens to consume all of New York.

title: Silver Sable
description: Silver Sable and her Wild Pack hunt Spider-Man while Deadpool — reimagined as a reality TV host — adds chaos. A fan-favorite lighter arc before the Clone Saga.

title: Ultimate Clone Saga
description: Multiple Peter Parker clones emerge, including the female clone later known as Spider-Woman. Bendis's take on the Clone Saga is tighter, more focused, and genuinely disturbing.

title: Ultimate Knights
description: Spider-Man joins Daredevil's underground alliance against the Kingpin in a long-building payoff to years of Kingpin conflict.

title: Death of a Goblin
description: Norman Osborn escapes prison and the Green Goblin returns for a final confrontation with Harry. One of the most emotionally devastating arcs of the run.

title: War of the Symbiotes
description: Venom returns and the symbiote war begins. Multiple symbiote hosts clash as Peter's past with Eddie Brock comes to a head.

title: Irresponsible
description: Peter struggles with balancing his Spider-Man life and school obligations. A quieter arc that sets up the emotional stakes before the heavier Venom story.

title: Superstars
description: Peter body-swaps with Wolverine, encounters Dr. Strange, and deals with the X-Men. A fun anthology arc featuring the broader Ultimate Marvel universe.

title: Ultimatum
description: The Ultimate universe's catastrophic Ultimatum event hits New York. Peter survives but the world around him is irrevocably changed.

title: The New World According to Peter Parker
description: Post-Ultimatum, Peter rebuilds. The Chameleon arc gives way to Mysterio's manipulation in Tainted Love — the final long arc before Death of Spider-Man.

title: Deadpool
description: Spider-Man and Kitty Pryde are captured by Ultimate Deadpool — reimagined as a reality TV host — who hunts mutants on Krakoa. A fan-favourite lighter arc with the X-Men.

title: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends
description: Liz Allen's mutant powers emerge, leading to a crossover with the X-Men. Marks the transition from Bagley to Immonen as the book's artist.

title: Chameleons
description: The Ultimate Chameleon impersonates Peter, nearly destroying his relationships with MJ and Gwen while uncovering his secret identity.

title: Morbius
description: Spider-Man investigates a vampire case involving Ben Urich and encounters Morbius, a vampire hunter. Discovers his spider-DNA makes him immune to vampirism.

title: The Talk
description: A special transitional issue (#111) where Aunt May learns Peter is Spider-Man and gives her support. Marks Mark Bagley's handover to Stuart Immonen as artist.

title: Omega Red
description: A spotlight issue (#121) where Spider-Man and Omega Red clash at the Daily Bugle. Also features the first appearance of Ned Leeds.

title: The Worst Day in Peter Parker's Life
description: Issue #122 where Spider-Man faces the Shocker while his double life spirals. First appearances of Ultimate Adrian Toomes and the Beetle.

title: Death of Spider-Man Prelude
description: The Superhero Training arc and the buildup to Death of Spider-Man. Peter gets training from Captain America as Norman Osborn secretly escapes custody.

title: Death of Spider-Man
description: Peter Parker is shot, then makes one final stand against the Sinister Six at his home to protect his family. His death is one of the most celebrated moments in Ultimate Marvel history.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man: A New World
description: An older Peter Parker becomes Spider-Man for the first time in the rebooted Ultimate Universe, balancing his family life with MJ and an emerging threat from Norman Osborn.
